binding_rule: Every public scientific statement must remain traceable to a source authority and an evidence role. External literature can support adjacent mechanisms, comparators and methods; internal authorities can support P-120 development-state and architecture-process claims. Neither may be promoted to a stronger evidence class than the source supports.

claim_level_rule.E0: External scientific foundation / adjacent science or methodological precedent
claim_level_rule.E1: P-120 internal architecture verification / controlled methodological record
claim_level_rule.E2: Human, cognitive or cross-check evidence actually collected and adjudicated

bindings.claim: COM-12 is designed as a distinct communication-process layer rather than a measure of motivation, attachment, sexual self-worth or preference content.
bindings.allowed_wording: Candidate communication architecture with controlled ownership boundaries.
bindings.prohibited_inference: The four COM domains are validated factors or establish communication competence in a clinical/diagnostic sense.

bindings.claim: COM development has progressed from a 32-item pool to a 24-item Cognitive Candidate with a controlled C1/C2/C3 field and evidence-adjudication protocol.
bindings.allowed_wording: Field execution ready; field evidence pending.
bindings.prohibited_inference: C1/C2/C3 have been completed or COM has passed psychometric validation.

bindings.claim: Communication around autonomy and boundaries is kept distinct from internal sexual authorship/autonomy.
bindings.allowed_wording: P-120 explicitly tests the distinction between internal authorship and interpersonal negotiation.
bindings.prohibited_inference: Sexual autonomy support literature validates COM-N or SELF-SAA as P-120 factors.

bindings.claim: MOT-12 asks why intimacy is chosen and keeps motivation distinct from desire strength, erotic activation and behavior.
bindings.allowed_wording: Candidate motivation architecture informed by adjacent motivation/desire research.
bindings.prohibited_inference: MOT family structure is confirmed or desire is measured inside MOT.

bindings.claim: Partner-responsive/communal and autonomy/control-related motive territories are plausible research targets but remain candidate territories.
bindings.allowed_wording: Established adjacent research provides precedents for studying partner-responsive and autonomy-related motivational processes.
bindings.prohibited_inference: External sources directly validate MOT-C/MOT-P/MOT-V or any MOT total.

bindings.claim: The 24-item Cognitive Candidate and expert/CVI/cognitive architecture are development evidence, not psychometric evidence.
bindings.prohibited_inference: Content validity, factor structure, reliability or norms have already been demonstrated.

bindings.claim: SELF-12 is a candidate sexual self-relation architecture with five CORE and two LIMITED territories, kept separate from general self-esteem, communication, attachment, motivation, embodied awareness and preferences.
bindings.allowed_wording: Internally adjudicated candidate architecture; external evidence coverage is being reconciled.
bindings.prohibited_inference: The seven territories are validated factors or constitute a SELF Total.

bindings.claim: Sexual agency/autonomy is treated as an internal authorship territory and is tested against neighboring communication and temporal-activation owners.
bindings.allowed_wording: Sexual autonomy research provides an adjacent scientific anchor for the candidate SAA territory.
bindings.prohibited_inference: REF-040 establishes the full SELF architecture or validates SAA scoring.

bindings.claim: SELF PASS 6 freezes evidence-gathering architecture, not factor structure or final item selection.
bindings.allowed_wording: Expert/CVI/cognitive architecture controlled and ready; evidence state remains separately tracked.
bindings.prohibited_inference: Expert/CVI/cognitive results exist unless separately supplied and adjudicated.

bindings.claim: LIFE is a downstream outcome/spillover layer rather than a psychosexual trait layer and does not encode causal attribution.
bindings.allowed_wording: Candidate outcome/spillover architecture; temporal association/covariation language only.
bindings.prohibited_inference: Intimacy causes changes in mood, vitality, sleep, work/study engagement or meaning.

bindings.claim: LIFE preserves separate outcome territories and temporal modes and prohibits a LIFE Total.
bindings.allowed_wording: Six CORE candidate outcomes plus limited/auxiliary CCO; GLS treated as an external anchor in the current architecture.
bindings.prohibited_inference: Six confirmed factors, a global wellness/sexual-energy score, or interchangeable temporal modes.

bindings.claim: The current 45-reference public library does not fully cover the independent external evidence landscape for vitality, sleep, work/study engagement, meaning and cognitive carryover.
bindings.allowed_wording: Selected adjacent anchors are available; module-specific source reconciliation remains required for full external coverage.
bindings.prohibited_inference: The current 45-reference Core/public library is a complete LIFE literature review.

bindings.claim: RPE-MOD remains an optional specialized Extended layer under fielding hold and a stricter pre-pilot publication boundary.
bindings.prohibited_inference: Detailed construct-family publication, public scoring, norms, archetypes or participant recommendations.

bindings.claim: P-120 uses explicit scale-development, measurement, invariance and model-testing principles as methodological references.
bindings.allowed_wording: Methodological precedents inform the validation programme.
bindings.prohibited_inference: Following methodological standards itself proves validity.

bindings.claim: EXT-SYS ownership, redundancy and information-gain audits are methodological safeguards against uncontrolled module expansion.
bindings.allowed_wording: The system uses explicit ownership, redundancy and incremental-information gates during development.
bindings.prohibited_inference: Desk-stage red-team PASS demonstrates empirical discriminant or incremental validity.

bindings.claim: Dyadic methodology is a separate future/publication-gated layer and is not inferred from one-person profiles.
bindings.allowed_wording: Reserved methodological context only; public DYADIC remains hidden.
bindings.prohibited_inference: Current individual P-120 data establish couple compatibility.
